facts.title: Un-common Components for shadcn/ui | Skiper UI
facts.description: Brand new uncommon components for your Next.js project. Use with ease through shadcn CLI 3.0, featuring fast-growing components and collections that are easy to edit and use.
facts.keywords: shadcn/ui,react components,nextjs,ui library,tailwind css,typescript,web components,design system

research.name: Skiper UI
research.note: Uncommon shadcn/ui components modeled on product interactions, such as a Dynamic Island, Vercel tooltips and preloaders.

effects: Dynamic Island component with states such as ring, timer, airdrop and find my
Product-inspired interactions such as Vercel Tooltip, Aave token swap and Family wallet
Preloaders and scroll effects such as stairs preloader, ASCII simulation and canvas crowd

unverified: The site marks its newest components as New without dates; 2026-08-29 is the first Wayback Machine capture of the newest one (skiper107), not a release date.
No public repository with the component source was found; the founder's GitHub (Gurvinder-Singh02) has no such repository.
